source_text: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Alan,{PART_001}you are insightful.{PART_002}You must know that.{PART_003}We need you.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Bautista!{PART_001}No,{PART_002}we need you to decode this message.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}It's probably been 2 months since I've last helped with anything.{PART_001}I hardly help solve the transmissions,{PART_002}I don't program our computer,{PART_003}and I don't do any linguistic analysis.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}But you start the discussion,{PART_001}Alan.{PART_002}You spark ideas.{PART_003}Even if you're wrong,{PART_004}you get us to think in a new way.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I speak a lot,{PART_001}that's for certain.{PART_002}I s'pose there's a minimal amount of help there,{PART_003}though I'd hardly call it expertise.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}It's something YOU accomplished.{PART_001}You start the conversations,{PART_002}but if that's not enough,{PART_003}then look to the The Hydrogen Line.{PART_004}The very first transmission.{PART_005}The basis for every frequency we've received.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}If it weren't for you recognizing that specific frequency,{PART_001}would we be this far?{PART_002}We could've been stuck for weeks trying to deduce some meaning from those numbers.{PART_003}But you noticed the Hydrogen Line.{PART_004}You established our starting point.{PART_005}The aliens waved hello and you were there to see it.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I know.{PART_001}It's been my pride and joy these past four months.{PART_002}But that's it.{PART_003}I'm running on fumes of achievement.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}We're a team Alan.{PART_001}All of this is your achievement.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}The Hydrogen Line is my achievement.{PART_001}That's all I have to hang my hat on.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}You must know that there was a reason Doppler wanted you for this mission.{PART_001}You know the universe better than any of us.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}I have something to say.{PART_001}...{PART_002}Many years ago,{PART_003}my older brother played in the Los Angeles Philharmonic.

{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Mmhm.{PART_001}He even became the third chair percussionist.{PART_002}So he invited the whole family to his debut with the orchestra.{PART_003}The first percussionist was standing with the snare drum,{PART_004}a triangle,{PART_005}and an array of other instruments.{PART_006}$animB5My brother was sitting 2 chairs over.{PART_007}He remained sitting for most of the performance.{PART_008}...{PART_009}I thought back.{PART_010}At age 8,{PART_011}my brother was playing Beethoven on the piano.{PART_012}Come high school,{PART_013}he was first chair percussionist in the school band.{PART_014}Each time he visited from college,{PART_015}he showed me a new instrument he had learned.{PART_016}And now,{PART_017}he was third chair in the entire symphony.{PART_018}Yet he was sitting.{PART_019}...{PART_020}Nearly 10 minutes had passed and he had hardly played a single note.{PART_021}He hardly played at all that night.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I'm sorry to hear that...{PART_001}$animA2Another passionate soul,{PART_002}lost to the crowd.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}That is how I thought.{PART_001}At first.{PART_002}Though after some thinking,{PART_003}I realized:{PART_004}$animB0It was all the part asked of him.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}$animA4That's the point!{PART_001}It's a shame to waste that,{PART_002}to waste such talent!{PART_003}He sounds like a brilliant performer.{PART_004}$animA5The symphony should have had him play more.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}$animB3Would the songs have been better if he played more notes?
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Huh.{PART_001}Four years at undergrad,{PART_002}five years at grad school,{PART_003}and nearly a decade with the space agency...
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I did not expect such linguistic sentimentality from you guys.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}What is this message?{PART_001}Why is this information familiar?
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Because we have seen it all in previous transmissions.{PART_001}This is a data dump.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I see.{PART_001}This is all the astronomical data they've shared.{PART_002}Hahaha,{PART_003}gee that's something.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}What happens if we put it all together?
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Are they quizzing us?{PART_001}The past few transmissions have been quite different from the usual structure.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Normally we learn a word,{PART_001}then test it in a few different ways.{PART_002}This time we learned 4 terms in a row,{PART_003}and now we've been quizzed for four transmission in a row on those aforementioned words.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hey,{PART_001}I'm lovin' it.{PART_002}I'm happy to bask in my specialty.{PART_003}If they want to quiz me on how they define astronomical bodies,{PART_004}I'll be here all day!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hey guys check it!!{PART_001}It's {SIG_N053} again!{PART_002}{PLAYER_NAME},{PART_003}switch to the Visual tab!!{PART_004}C'mon I wanna see what they're drawing!!
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}{PLAYER_NAME},{PART_001}you do as you wish.{PART_002}You are the leader of this team.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}That confirms it.{PART_001}We're classifying words and learning their grammar!
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}These newest signals hardly carry a meaning themselves.{PART_001}They  categorize other words based on their syntax and semantics!!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Is there any reason any of us non-linguists should care?

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Hey!{PART_001}This is exciting!{PART_002}And yes,{PART_003}you should care!{PART_004}If we know their parts of speech,{PART_005}imagine how much faster we can define new words!!
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}We're learning how they speak,{PART_001}Alan!{PART_002}This is a new frontier!{PART_003}This is their language!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hey {PLAYER_NAME},{PART_001}do you think you could do the math?{PART_002}Convert the units and find out:{PART_003}What is this total {SIG_N065}?
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I'd say so.{PART_001}That last transmission tells us when the {SIG_N044} was first sent.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}So 1 is more than 2,{PART_001}and 2 is more than 8,{PART_002}and that's more than something else,{PART_003}and then 10,{PART_004}and then 26,{PART_005}then 7.{PART_006}It's not even increasing by number.
